name: Complete ten-task study, Head-RegMean and standard LoRM
authorization: User directly approved six ten-task runs at alpha .05, then independently approved new shared 20GB budget with all history preserved on 2026-10-26. Alpha .5 is deferred.
queue: Seed0 both methods on GPUs3/6 concurrently; after both qualify, seed1 pair then seed2 pair. No performance gate, no T2/T3 early elimination. Only technical correctness, resource and common deadline can block admission.
initialization: Fresh same pinned pretrained weights and existing complete ten-task seed-specific manifests. No continuation from short-study checkpoint.
head: Mature ConfirmationPilot: current-only CE jointly updates current cosine head and B. Fixed RRS A, original SSB B, sample-weighted B FedAvg, local-endpoint Gram constrained spherical Head-RegMean alpha .5, cosine16, rank32, B lr .0002, head AdamW .001 wd0. Fixed centered inference; raw always reported.
head_numerics: Fresh FP32 deterministic algorithms, math SDPA, TF32 off, CUBLAS :4096:8. Disclosed difference from older non-deterministic confirmation; not evidence resolving its failed exact pair.
lorm: Pinned official 6d57b5d361f743f3ff0cd1371409bd7a1158de64, unchanged standard config: rank16, AdamW .0005 wd0, A/B alternating, linear+bias head, 16-mixed, regmean_all, head alpha .5/backbone0, one Gram pass. All original round and temporal task-end evaluations kept.
contrast_limit: Algorithms differ in architecture/optimizer/numerics; comparative study, not a single-mechanism causal ablation. Report all six without test-based fitting/selection.
excluded: No teacher/old-response, all-seen training loss, feature anchor, orthogonal head, transported head, prototype, ridge, extra seeds or alpha .5 runs.
qualification: Ten-task toy exact compact-vs-default trajectory and boundary recovery including T3-to-T4; original solver/lifecycle tests. Actual each run 500 unique client-rounds, 1.25M train image visits, ten complete stages. Head 50 deployed certificates/ten merges/history commits/zero B/full raw+centered confusion reload; LoRM complete task10 boundary and all 10000 final raw+centered predictions reproduced from checkpoint.
reporting: Both raw and fixed centered lower-triangular accuracy matrices
a_tt for every task and mean new accuracy T2-T10
final overall/old/new, average incremental accuracy, forgetting
task-restricted accuracy and block competition from same logits
per-seed values and paired mean/sample std
training/statistics/evaluation/communication/wall time/storage cost with unequal method costs disclosed
retention: Only atomic latest full checkpoint per run; no new task snapshots or round endpoint files. All stage metrics, events, certificates and private task logits retained. All older directories untouched.

resources.shared_clock: All six runs, children and any authorized repair share first actual group execution time. No reset. CPU preflight cost disclosed separately.
resources.shared_read_only: Existing data/deps/official source/weights via symlinks; no copies or downloads.
resources.prior_root_rule: Original 45GB guard/50GB ledger and interrupted original queue remain unchanged; independent new budget is explicit user exception, not cleanup or restart.

old_results: All old negative/partial results and failed RegMean/FedAvg exact pairing retained as failures. Transport T2 finishes under its existing protocol and does not spawn another short variant or block this study.
privacy: Only code/protocol/text results public. Data, weights, Grams, feature/checkpoint tensors, private per-image logits remain server-private.
test_limit: Shared CIFAR test development set; seed replication is not independent held-out validation.
